title: Let’s Have Fun

instructions.pb-6: 6. Listen to the following sounds and words, then repeat them.
instructions.wb-6: 6. Write and draw about what you like doing.

printed.pb-1-block: What do you like doing? I like collecting shells. I like water skiing. Do you like playing the guitar? Yes, I do. I don’t like playing the piano. What do you like doing? We like playing chess. I like listening to music.
printed.pb-2-block: 1- What do you like doing? I like collecting stamps. 2- Do you like playing the piano? Yes, I do. / No, I don’t.
printed.pb-3-block: What do you like doing? I like playing basketball. Do you like playing tennis? No, I don’t.
printed.pb-4-block: Two numbered rows of two pictures each, with one tick circle per picture. The recording determines the ticks.
printed.pb-5-block: What do you like doing? What do you like doing? Playing chess, playing chess. Swimming in the sea, swimming in the sea. Collecting things, collecting things. What do you like doing? What do you like doing?
printed.wb-1-block: 1- I like playing the piano. 2- I don’t like watching TV. 3- She doesn’t like playing tennis. 4- I like swimming in the sea.
printed.wb-2-block: Word bank: playing · listening · watching · collecting. 1- We like …… to music. 2- He likes …… TV. 3- They like …… shells. 4- Mike likes …… the guitar.
printed.wb-3-block: Activities: 1- listening to music 2- playing chess 3- collecting stamps 4- reading books. The printed example for item 1 is “I like listening to music.”
printed.wb-4-block: Four pictures, each with a circle for the number. The recording determines the numbers.
